example_sentences_in_bangla: বসন্তের সকালে পাখির কলস্বন শুনে মন ভরে ওঠে।
তার গানের কলস্বন সকলকে মুগ্ধ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: The cuckoo's sweet chirping fills the heart in spring mornings.
Her song has a melodious sound that captivates everyone.
history: Refers to the natural sound of birds, especially the cuckoo, commonly featured in Bengali poetry and folklore.
note: Often associated with the koel (cuckoo) bird in Bengali culture, symbolizing spring and romance.
